questions.question: Which service is commonly a local government responsibility?
choices: Issuing national currency
Negotiating international treaties
Maintaining local streets
Commanding the national military

questions.question: What is a municipal ordinance?

questions.question: What does zoning primarily regulate?

Congressional committee membership

A map dividing the city into neighborhoods
